criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both use elevated oblique map projection.
Diagonal ground axes organize buildings and transmission routes.
different: REFERENCE F02 has long valley-depth framing; CANDIDATE F02 retains a tight city-board view.
The CANDIDATE's steeper view and exposed diamond grid flatten world depth.

evidence.observation: F01 presents an elevated industrial map with diagonal roads and infrastructure.
F01 uses a comparable oblique projection and diagonal ground alignment.
F02 frames a broad valley with substantial distance from foreground plant to far landmark.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: A sinuous dark channel crosses industrial terrain in both systems.
Each F02 places infrastructure and a crossing beside a widened water corridor.
different: REFERENCE water has recessed shaded banks and subdued reflections; CANDIDATE flooding has flatter blue fill and hard tile-like edges.
CANDIDATE F02 inundates several city blocks, while REFERENCE water remains a naturally bounded valley channel.

evidence.observation: F01 contains a narrow winding channel embedded among roads and industrial terrain.
F02 shows a deep, naturally curved river with a bridge near the lower middle.
F02 expands the channel into a broad, bright polygonal flood footprint around buildings and routes.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use charcoal metal, dark concrete, rocky soil, and sparse amber lights.
Cyan illumination contrasts against muted industrial midtones in both.
different: CANDIDATE ground tiles and building sprites separate more visibly than the REFERENCE's painterly cohesion.
REFERENCE F02 has warmer ochre atmosphere; CANDIDATE remains cooler and more uniformly charcoal.

evidence.observation: Blackened industrial surfaces, granular terrain, warm windows, and cool grid light form a cohesive scene.
The same dark metal, concrete, soil, amber, and cyan palette is immediately visible.
F02 adds atmospheric brown midtones and softly integrated natural terrain.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both distinguish cyan energized conductors from amber dashed routes.
Repeated pylons and multi-strand glowing lines make transmission paths prominent.
different: CANDIDATE F02 has substantially denser, thicker cyan routing with weaker route hierarchy around the flood.
Several CANDIDATE runs bend abruptly or overlap structures, while REFERENCE routes follow clearer corridors.

evidence.observation: F01 clearly separates a cyan upper network from an amber dashed lower corridor with towers.
F01 reproduces cyan and amber route coding with regularly spaced pylons.
F02 fills much of the map with thick cyan loops and crossings, reducing individual-route readability.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Blue water remains embedded in a dark industrial infrastructure context.
Both presentations retain buildings, pylons, and routes around the environmental condition.
different: CANDIDATE F01 and F02 preserve one camera and landmark layout while visibly expanding the water; REFERENCE F01 and F02 show different regions and framing.
CANDIDATE presents an overt hard-edged inundation footprint, whereas REFERENCE panels show naturally bounded channels without a directly matched before/after view.

evidence.observation: F01 is a tight industrial district with a narrow channel.
F02 changes to a separate broad valley composition with different landmarks and camera depth.
F01 establishes the persistent city, pylons, routes, and narrow pre-flood channel.
